meta_title: Night Food Tours in Malaysia | Simply Enak
meta_description: Malaysia's food scene transforms after dark. Night markets, late-night hawkers, and hidden bars - experience KL and Penang after sunset.
hero_description: When the sun sets, a different food scene wakes up. Night markets, charcoal grills firing up, and the smell of satay drifting through the streets. These are our after-dark tours.

translations.meta_description: Suasana makanan Malaysia berubah selepas gelap. Pasar malam, penjaja larut malam dan bar tersembunyi - alami KL dan Pulau Pinang selepas matahari terbenam.
